label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss) is a True Positive. The source 'param' (derived from decoding a cookie value set by the client) flows directly to the sink expression on lines 104-110 via the chain: getValue -> decode -> ... -> new String(input) -> encodeForHTML(...). Although encodeForHTML sanitizes the string content, the resulting encoded string is concatenated into the HTML response output ('... + ...'), making the entire response vulnerable to XSS via reflected user input. The resolved sink value depends entirely on the attacker-controlled 'param'.

evidence.note: Sink expression concatenates user-controlled input (via param) into HTML response after encoding.
